hero.headline: AI agents for faster sales
hero.subheadline: A composable suite to automate prospecting, qualification, follow-up and sales ops.

problem.headline: Your team works. The data disappears.
problem.para1: Every meeting generates information. That information ends up in WhatsApp, in someone's head, or nowhere at all. Leads go cold. Follow-ups don't happen. Managers don't know what's going on.
problem.para2: It's not a people problem. It's a process problem.

solution.headline: Agents that work where your team already works.
solution.body: WhatsApp, Excel, the platforms you've used for years. Nothing to install, nothing to learn. Flowmeup configures everything around your existing process.

agents.headline: Four agents. One sales process without friction.
agents.subheadline: Activate one at a time. Or all together.

differentiator.headline: What the team knows, Flowmeup knows.
differentiator.body: All agents share the same company memory. A lead logged today is available to the whole team in real time, whether Marco added it from his phone or Giulia from the CRM. No re-briefing, no copy-pasting, no parallel spreadsheets.

delivery.headline: Live within one week.
delivery.subheadline: Done for you. Tell us how your team works. We configure everything.

pricing.headline: Clear pricing. Pay for what you use.
pricing.setup: One-time setup €300: configuration, integration, onboarding included.
pricing.noBind: Then only the agents you activate, month by month. No annual contracts.

contact.subheadline: 30 minutes to see if Flowmeup is the right fit for you.
